answer: An adversary seeking to fabricate identities must lock staking collateral into a thread of sequential attestations; each non‑refundable fee compounds the opportunity cost of idle capital, while a zero‑knowledge verifiable delay enforces a ridge of time‑locked exposure that amplifies slashing penalties proportionally to the square of forged stake, guaranteeing negative expected attack utility and establishing a robust Nash equilibrium.
